//OpenApi: The v1 document (/openapi/v1.json) and its Scalar reference UI (/scalar/v1). Deliberately absent here: the default is on in Development and off everywhere else, because the document is a complete map of every endpoint, parameter and schema. Set OpenApi:Enabled (or OpenApi__Enabled=true) to publish it from a staging or internal environment.

Jwt.//SigningKey: SECRET — never set here. user-secrets locally, environment or Key Vault elsewhere. Startup fails if unset or under 32 bytes.
Jwt.//AccessTokenLifetime: Deliberately absent (M7): this path is now a declared setting (security.access_token_minutes) whose code-level default lives in PlatformSettingDefinitions, not here — an operator override belongs in the settings console or a stored row, not a hardcoded default that would masquerade as one.

Security.//LoginPolicy: Deliberately absent (M7): MaxFailedAttempts, LockoutDuration, RefreshTokenLifetime and MinimumPasswordLength are now declared settings (security.*) whose code-level defaults live in PlatformSettingDefinitions — see the note on Jwt:AccessTokenLifetime above.

RateLimiting.//SignInAttemptsPerWindow: Deliberately absent (M7): now the declared setting security.sign_in_attempts_per_window — see the note on Jwt:AccessTokenLifetime above.
RateLimiting.//SignInWindow: Deliberately absent (M7): this TimeSpan path is dead and nothing reads it any more. The declared setting security.sign_in_window_seconds overlays the int path RateLimiting:SignInWindowSeconds instead — an int value at this TimeSpan path would bind as a number of days, not seconds — see the note on Jwt:AccessTokenLifetime above.
